blocks.html: Ever wondered what paradise looks like? Your 10-day holiday on Zanzibar will show you.

blocks.orig: Just a hop, skip, and a ferry ride from Tanzania’s Dar es Salaam away lies Zanzibar, a unique island welcoming you with its white sandy beaches, the glistening Indian Ocean and palm trees radiating postcard vibes.
blocks.html: A short hop and a ferry ride from Dar es Salaam in Tanzania brings you to Zanzibar, a one-of-a-kind island that greets you with white sandy beaches, the sparkling Indian Ocean and palm trees straight off a postcard.

blocks.orig: Get a feeling for the island’s culture, travel back in time visiting ancient sights and dive deep into the ocean snorkelling. From relaxation par excellence to adrenalin-fuelled adventures – Zanzibar has it all.
blocks.html: Soak up the island’s culture, step back in time at historic sights and go snorkelling deep in the ocean. Whether you’re after pure relaxation or adrenaline-packed adventure, Zanzibar offers it all.

blocks.orig: Many travelers ask us when the best time is to visit Tanzania. The answer is … there is not one right answer. It depends on what you want to see, where you want to go, your budget and interests. Please find a comprehensive guide on when is the best time to visit Tanzania here.
blocks.html: A common question from travellers is when they should visit Tanzania. The honest answer: there isn’t a single right one. It depends on what you’re hoping to see, where you want to travel, your budget and your interests. Have a look at our comprehensive guide on the best time to visit Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: Our safaris give you the opportunity to explore Tanzania’s incredible wildlife and beautiful landscapes. Private safaris are what we specialise in, so the 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep is for you and your group only. If you’d like to see the animals when they’re most active, at sunrise and sunset when the temperatures are pleasant, or if you’d rather end the day at the pool, it’s entirely your choice. Tanzania’s varied wildlife is active at different times of day, so you’ll have many opportunities to see the animals in action.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, absolutely. Tanzania is widely known as one of the top places to see the Big Five. Lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo can all be watched in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a firm favourite with wildlife enthusiasts.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, absolutely. Tanzania is a safe and welcoming country for visitors. It’s a hospitable place, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, and you can discover its scenery and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and it’s always wise to take sensible precautions, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, just as you would elsewhere in the world. Thanks to its natural beauty and warm people, Tanzania is a fantastic place to visit.

blocks.orig: Welcome to Zanzibar, a tropical paradise in the Indian Ocean! Discover pristine white sandy beaches, turquoise waters, and vibrant coral reefs teeming with marine life. Immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Stone Town, a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its ancient architecture and bustling markets. Indulge in the tantalizing flavors of Zanzibari cuisine, a fusion of African, Arab, and Indian influences. Experience the warmth and hospitality of the Swahili people as they share their fascinating traditions and stories. Get ready for an unforgettable journey filled with beauty, adventure, and relaxation in Zanzibar!
blocks.html: Welcome to Zanzibar, a tropical paradise in the Indian Ocean! Explore unspoilt white sandy beaches, turquoise water and colourful coral reefs full of marine life. Dive into the rich cultural heritage of Stone Town, a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its historic architecture and busy markets. Treat yourself to the enticing flavours of Zanzibari cuisine, a blend of African, Arab and Indian influences. Enjoy the warmth and hospitality of the Swahili people as they share their fascinating traditions and stories with you. Get ready for an unforgettable trip full of beauty, adventure and relaxation in Zanzibar!

blocks.orig: Ultimate paradise is here: gorgeous, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean and the palm-fringed, white sandy beaches are almost too beautiful to be true. Buy your coconut drink fresh on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and taste the delicious Zanzibari food. In the mood for something active? Then explore the beach, ocean, and island through a range of activities! We highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a tour of Stone Town.
blocks.html: Paradise is right here: lovely, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue Indian Ocean and the white sandy beaches lined with palms seem almost too beautiful to be real. Pick up a fresh coconut drink on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and try the tasty Zanzibari food. Feel like being active? Then discover the beach, the ocean and the island through a variety of activities! We strongly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a Stone Town tour.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or explore the island just a little bit more. Then, make your way to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to extend your holiday to another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or see a little more of the island. Then head to Zanzibar International Airport in good time for your flight home. Not ready to leave yet? You can also extend your holiday on another tropical island, such as Mnemba, Pemba or Mafia!
